scope: Read-only source review while explore FM_CONTROL is running; does not certify future unfinished training/evaluation/report deliverables. No model or extra sampling calls. Root owns all fixes.

findings.priority: Before any stage could approach the8hour cap
findings.classification: Missing continuous hard-budget guard; not an observed overrun
findings.finding: GPU occupancy is checked only before the worker. Training checks wall deadline but sampling has neither deadline. A worker starting below8hours could cross8hours before the next startup check. The current4hour wall window makes this unlikely for this run, but the8hour hard requirement is not enforced locally.
findings.action: Check accumulated occupancy plus current lease time before each update and rollout; stop at a complete update, save complete state, and leave enough reserved time for the next atomic operation. Keep lock/CPU wait out of GPU-time accounting.

findings.priority: Must verify before repeat or CONFIRM dispatch
findings.classification: Weak stage authorization guard; these stages have not been run
findings.finding: The repeat phase is selectable without a positive DEV+quality decision. CONFIRM sampling requires only release.status=FROZEN; it does not bind the requested checkpoint to the five permitted model identities or require both independent repeat endpoints. Evaluation additionally requires a candidate hash, but that does not establish all release identities.
findings.action: Before repeat require frozen DEV decision, selected recipe/step and matching control. Before CONFIRM require frozen release listing exact hashes for START, explore candidate/control and repeat candidate/control; require completed independent repeat state and newseed before allowing any CONFIRM samples/scores.

findings.priority: Before using the advertised500to1000 staged resume
findings.classification: Concrete controller resume bug; current until1000 invocation unaffected
findings.finding: A successful until500 call creates complete.json with steps500. A later until1000 sees complete exists, skips worker launch, then asserts steps>=until. It does not use the valid500pointer to continue.
findings.action: Treat completion as satisfying only the recorded step: if completed step<until, resume from the validated pointer rather than assert. Preserve prior completion record as a stage receipt.

findings.classification: Missing full registered-input cache guard; no actual changed file observed
findings.finding: Worker validates START hash in protocol but does not compare current pool manifest bytes with protocol.manifest_sha256 before loading/sampling. Cached result reuse checks checkpoint/raw hashes but does not validate current request bank hash or result request/condition identity. A changed same-ID request could therefore reuse unrelated cached geometry.
findings.action: Before model load verify frozen protocol and selected manifest hash. For cached results validate request_id/split/checkpoint/bank/condition identities as well as raw and export hashes; current requests can be reconstructed from immutable manifests without any new generation.

verified: Correct retained OT_HYBRID pilot1000/total5000 START, strict original model/AdamW state and optimizer step5000 restoration; new current steps are5000+feedback_step.

Primary8microbatch stream retains free-only original OT, FP32 mixed HYBRID target and lambda.25, 8distinct parents, 4unit+4uniform widths,32train parents. Original FM denominator sums all8 valid free scalar counts.
Auxiliary replay uses genuine16START Euler50 paths on TRAIN_FEEDBACK only; all16 payload mappings recover original GT exactly and all51C states match. No DEV/CONFIRM score is used to prepare replay.

Auxiliary CPU scores only select a supervised example. training.update differentiates .1*masked_fm_loss(model_velocity, detached_GT_based_target) with real model backward; model inputs remain xt/t/N/masks. No score constant is presented as a generator gradient.

Auxiliary x1 retains the true matched GT free coordinates and exact C; collate_aux overrides Xt/u exactly. Primary collation is unchanged. Both auxiliary arms share parent/noise/time and one additional forward/backward.

Optimizer updates and all forward/backward/sampling attempts are reserved before calls. Global6000update,512rollout,128feedback,25600NFE,64precheckF/32precheckB and160000sample-equivalent forward caps exist. All model batches are1.

500/1000DEV sampling is invoked by the training worker, with CPU scoring and galleries driven independently. Shape quality and interval-conservative three-metric gates are separate; severe I/E parent regressions are separately retained.

Four mesh views plus wireframe, same per-parent frames, C-blue/free-orange including GT, and three metric overlays exist in visualization code. AI_VISUAL_REVIEW remains pending until images are actually reviewed.

No default model change, no extra generator parameters, no MOMENT/SURFACE/UCorr/endpoint snapping inserted. The current pool is intentionally frozen START and can become off-policy; this limitation is stated in its specification.
